Class UserTotp

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.entities.UserTotp
@Entity public class UserTotp extends Object
The authenticator-app second factor (RFC 6238) of one user. It holds the active secret, which the password sign-in checks while enabled is set, and beside it a pending secret of a setup that has not been confirmed yet. Only a confirmed enrolment or a disabling changes the active secret, so an abandoned setup never weakens a protected sign-in.

Both secrets must be readable to compute codes and are therefore encrypted with ConnectorApiKey.stringEncryptor(), keyed by JASYPT_ENCRYPTOR_PASSWORD. No getter exposes them to Jackson and the class has no toString of its own. The entity is never sent over REST.
